defects.rationale: filename is interpolated into an f-string passed to os.system, which runs via the shell; a filename like 'a; rm -rf /' executes arbitrary commands.
os.system's exit status is returned without being checked, so conversion failures are silently propagated as a nonzero int rather than handled.
